basic.prompt:
Edit target: the attached ORIGINAL in-game pixel sprite of Moku. This is a strict character-preserving expression edit, NOT a redesign. Make a comparison sprite sheet with EIGHT subtle emotion variants of this EXACT sprite, in a precise 4-column by 2-row equal-cell grid. Genuinely transparent RGBA background; NO background color, glow, gradient, shadows, text, labels, borders, or grid lines.

CRITICAL IDENTITY: faithfully preserve the original's head-to-body ratio, apparent adult age (29-year-old woman), same slightly scruffy black bob/fringe, narrow half-lidded tired reddish eyes, same black cat ears and tail, loose worn white shirt, dark shorts, sandals, thin casual slouching body, original pixel scale/clustered shading and restrained desaturated colors. Her character is a lethargic, disheveled, mildly insolent heavy-smoking adult who drinks, not a sweet innocent child. Do not make her more youthful, round-eyed, glamorous, polished, affectionate, or cute. No doll-like glossy round eyes, no baby cheeks, no kawaii posing. The original sprite's distinctive weary face and casual posture are the foundation in EVERY cell.

MANDATORY PROPS IN ALL EIGHT CELLS: keep a lit CIGARETTE held at the corner of her MOUTH, with a small thin wisp of smoke as in the original, AND keep the same alcoholic drink CAN carried LOW beside her hip in the SAME HAND as the reference. Both props must be clearly visible in EVERY cell. Never remove the can, never replace it with another object, never put the cigarette in a hand. The can-holding arm stays low. Her free arm generally hangs loosely. Do not clasp both hands, clench both fists, raise both arms, or touch both hands to the chest. No dramatic body pose change; original feet, body height and clothes stay consistent.

Row 1, left to right:
1 HAPPY: still half-lidded, one corner of mouth curls into a wry smug smile around the cigarette; relaxed slouch, subtle ear lift. Not cheerful childlike happiness.
2 ANGRY: narrowed annoyed eyes and slightly lowered brows, mouth tightening around cigarette, a small forward shoulder lean. Fed up, not a cute tantrum.
3 SAD: mouth loses its smirk, downcast eyes, shoulders sink, ears droop a little, can still low in hand. Restrained dejection.
4 SURPRISED: brows lift and tired eyes open somewhat (not huge circles), mouth slackens slightly while retaining cigarette. Small recoil, not both hands raised.
Row 2, left to right:
5 CONFUSED: one brow raised, slight head tilt, skeptical half-lidded gaze, free hand loose or a minimal palm-up gesture.
6 SCARED: her usual weary confidence falters, eyes open moderately, tense shoulders and pinned ears, slight lean away; she still grips her can and retains cigarette. Serious unease, no exaggerated toddler crying.
7 RELIEVED: shoulders ease, faint tired smile, eyelids return to their habitual droop; almost identical posture to original.
8 SHY / AWKWARD: eyes look aside, small uncomfortable mouth, a faint flush only, still slouched and holding both signature props. Adult embarrassed discomfort, not bashful idol posing.

All eight sprites stand facing slightly right like the reference, feet centered on one common baseline per row, equal visual scale, large clean gaps between cells. Entire body, can, ears, tail and cigarette smoke must stay inside each cell. Keep each variant very close to the supplied original, as if the original sprite artist had drawn a few edits to eyes, mouth, ears and shoulders. Fine crisp pixel art only, no softened painted texture.
basic.repairPrompt: Precise local correction of the attached eight-frame pixel sprite sheet. Change ONLY the bottom-left cell (row 2, column 1, confused expression): its raised palm is currently empty. Restore the SAME gold/silver alcoholic drink can held LOW by her hip in her hand on the viewer's RIGHT, exactly like the other seven cells. Lower that forearm naturally so the can is carried beside her shorts. Keep her confused head tilt, half-lidded eyes, cigarette in mouth, and smoke. The opposite hand remains hanging loosely. Preserve all other seven sprites, layout, pixel-art style, character size, outlines, colors, faces, body proportions, clothing, hair, tail and ears EXACTLY. All eight cells must visibly include BOTH a mouth cigarette AND the gold/silver drink can. Preserve transparent RGBA background, without adding any background, glow, grid or text.

strong.prompt:
Create EIGHT ADDITIONAL STRONG EMOTION sprites of Moku for the existing game. Reference image 1 is the original in-game sprite, the authority for identity, adult demeanor, outfit, proportions, cigarette and beer can. Reference image 2 is her existing subtle 8-emotion sheet, the authority for matching sprite rendering and scale. These new eight must convey CLEARLY STRONGER body language, not repeat the existing subtle expressions.

Output exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, equal rectangular cells on genuinely transparent RGBA background, no text, labels, grid, borders, glow, colored gradient, floor or background. Each cell contains one full-body pixel-art Moku with room for her ears, tail and cigarette smoke; equal character scale and foot baseline. Preserve original adult 29-year-old woman's appearance: scruffy BLACK bob with straight bangs, black cat ears and tail, tired narrow reddish eyes when not shocked, loose worn white T-shirt, dark shorts, sandals, thin body, slouching casual silhouette. Same head-to-body ratio as references; do not infantilize or beautify, no glossy doll eyes, no cute toddler tantrums. Crisp original pixel clusters and desaturated shading.

ABSOLUTE PROP RULE IN EVERY SINGLE CELL: a lit cigarette remains gripped at the CORNER OF HER MOUTH with a thin smoke wisp; her hand on the viewer's RIGHT MUST hold the SAME silver-and-gold alcoholic drink can, low near her hip or slightly lifted as needed, NEVER absent. Only her other, free hand may gesture. No two free hands, no empty can-holding hand, no extra arms. Keep exact original outfit and identity. Strong emotion comes from eyes, mouth, shoulders, knees, ears and TAIL, not a new cute character.

Row 1 left to right:
1 FURIOUS / bristling rage: back tensed and slightly arched, ears pinned, narrowed furious eyes, free hand clenched in a low fist, shoulders thrust forward, BLACK TAIL VERY CLEARLY PUFFED UP WITH JAGGED RAISED FUR, large upright bristling silhouette. This is the key requested pose. Still cigarette and can. Adult fed-up anger, no cute tantrum.
2 PANIC / terror: sharply recoils on bent knees, ears fully flattened, tail rigid and puffed, alarmed eyes, free hand raised defensively. Clearly frightened adult, not baby crying. Can tightly gripped, cigarette retained.
3 DESPAIR / crushed grief: deeply slumped torso with head hanging, shoulders collapsed, ears hanging, tail limp on ground beside feet, eyes shadowed with restrained tears. Full standing/crouching body visible, not lying down. Can hangs low from fingers; cigarette still in mouth.
4 DESPERATE APPEAL / pleading: leaning forward urgently, free arm reaching out with open hand toward someone, strained eyebrows and intense worried gaze, ears back, tail low and taut; firmly holds can in the other hand and cigarette in mouth. Sincere urgency.

Row 2 left to right:
5 STUNNED DISBELIEF: rigid frozen upright body slightly recoiled, ears upright, eyes widened but not doll-like, mouth slack around cigarette, free arm hanging stiffly; tail abruptly straight. Shocked silent adult, distinct from mild surprise.
6 LOUD ROUGH LAUGHTER: head tilted back a little, eyes squeezed in crooked amused arcs, shoulders shaking, free hand on belly, broad mischievous laugh with cigarette held at one mouth corner, can in other hand. Unrefined adult laughter, no sweet idol or childlike open-arm cheer.
7 DEEP EXASPERATION / utterly fed up: shoulders sag heavily, drooping ears, eyes nearly closed in exhausted annoyance, free hand covering brow in a weary facepalm, tail low; can remains low in other hand, cigarette at mouth corner and long thin sigh-like smoke.
8 STRONG REJECTION / disgust: leans away sideways, narrowed disgusted eyes and curled upper lip around cigarette, ears angled back, free palm pushes outward as if saying 'keep that away', tail curls sharply away. Adult irritated revulsion, not fear or cute shyness. Can still held clearly in other hand.

All eight should look like the SAME original scruffy, cynical, lethargic Moku expressing exceptional emotions. Keep body silhouettes and facial reactions individually readable at small in-game scale. Add no symbols, hearts, emojis, effect words or props other than the cigarette and can.
